prompt: Match each Redis structure to its canonical use case.
explanation: Each structure has a shape that fits one family of workloads: sequences suit feeds, field-value maps suit per-entity records, membership collections suit tags and uniqueness, score-ordered collections suit rankings, and append-only logs with IDs suit events.

pairs.right: Activity feed where newest entries land at the head
User profile whose fields are updated one at a time
The unique tags a blog post carries
Append-only event log read by consumer groups
